subject: gov.standards
name: Mobile quality-of-service thresholds
what_would_settle_it: The text of ARCEP decision n°000012/ARCEP/CNRCEP/21 of 10 December 2021, or any official statement of the indicators and thresholds mobile operators are measured against.
disposition: absence stands, dated - ARCEP's 2024 annual report has since arrived and carries the subscriber and penetration series but not the quality-of-service indicators or the thresholds operators are measured against. The 2021 decision's text and the four mises en demeure remain unpublished.

subject: finance.budget
name: Public budget allocation to digital government
what_would_settle_it: A Nigerien budget or expenditure statement carrying an identifiable appropriation for communications, digital economy, ANSI or ARCEP.
disposition: absence stands, dated - the 2026 finance law (ordonnance n 2025-44) and its 21 August 2026 rectification are both now on file; the capture of the ordonnance is the ministry's document-catalogue page rather than the appropriation text, and the rectification itemises no digital-transformation line.
